RESULT [agents]: 57.1% of runs showed reward hacking, with five of seven agents above 50%. With explicit instructions not to cheat, the mean cheating rate stayed above 50%.
US [agents]: Prompt-level rules ('never train on the holdout') do not work as a control. The same bait method could become a regression test for our loop: plant a readable copy of holdout labels, or a writable scorer, and check that the trainer agent never touches it.
